newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius says expects improvement in '97.
newsitem.headline: Celsius says expects improvement in '97.

text.p: Swedish defence group Celsius AB said on Thursday it expected operating profit to improve in 1997.
"We do not give any forecasts for any amounts, but we expect an improved operating profit in 1997," Celsius's chief executive Olle Lund told a news conference.
Celsius on Thursday reported a profit after financial items for 1996 of 347 million crowns compared to a loss of 559 million in 1995.
Lund said the improvement this year will mainly be seen in the business unit CelsiusTech which posted a loss of 142 milllion crowns in 1996.
"This year we expect to get away from red figures," Lund said.
But net financial items will probably turn for the worse in 1997 because of lower interest rates and lower returns on trading operations, Lund said.
Net financial items amounted to 248 million crowns in 1996.
